title: Run checks on pull requests with GitHub Actions
description: One workflow on pull requests to `develop` and `main`: LeftBlock scan, then per-site tests once a site exists. Use path filters so a change to one site tests only that site. The repository is public so the minutes are free.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in PR #1 (ddcb16f). ci.yml: LeftBlock-ruleset secret scan, kanbus validate, kanbus wiki lint, Conventional Commit PR title; aggregate job 'ci' is the one required check, app tests later = one more job in its needs. Actions pinned by SHA, no AWS access. Per-site path filters deliberately not used: they leave required checks pending on skipped runs; revisit when sites exist.
